detail.value: We cancelled on 2 March and would like the unused portion of the term refunded to the original card.
Twelve of the twenty seats on the March invoice were never activated and we are asking for those to be refunded.
The renewal went through after we had given notice, and we are asking for the full A$3,600.00 back rather than a credit.

closing.value: Could you confirm what the process is and how long it takes?
If this is not resolved this week we will ask our legal team to look at the contract.
Thank you for looking into it, we have been happy with the service otherwise.
